preview.markup.copyLanguageCode.comment: Accessibility label and spoken name of the margin button beside a code card whose language is recognized (decision 027, Q-73). Formatted: argument 1 is the language's own proper name, such as Swift, C++ or PowerShell, taken from a fixed table of names; do not translate or transliterate the argument, and keep it in the sentence where the target language puts the language name. No count and no plural. The button copies one already-concealed displayed code body through the existing privacy copy service; it never copies fences, labels or surrounding prose. When the language is unknown the existing 'Copy Code Block' string is used instead. All translations are drafts pending native-speaker review.
